consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the 1981-07-10 show at St. Paul Civic Center features a solid performance with standout moments, particularly in the second set. While some reviewers noted a lack of extended jams, many praised the energy and fun the band exhibited throughout the show.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.4 for 51 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While many fans enjoyed the show and highlighted specific performances, there were also critiques regarding the lack of extended jamming and overall excitement, leading to a mixed sentiment.
